description: Design applications from the ground up using gRPC to communicate between front-end and back-end.
Develop Front-End applications using Angular.js, leveraging events to make asynchronous updates to the views.
Develop full-stack applications with Django and SQL Server.
Create workflows with Copilot/Windsurf to automate repetitive tasks and improve everyday productivity.
Coordinate Scrum ceremonies with the team to create new features and take ownership of stories and bugs.
Worked as a contractor in the banking and finance area.
Developed RESTful APIs in Java 8 with Spring, JPA, MySQL, and Spring Boot.
Developed cloud solutions for the automation of the mortgage process in JavaScript with Node.js. Created IaaS with Terraform and monitored endpoint calls and errors using DataDog and Kibana.
Synced up with the team using Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) and collaborated using GitLab.
Led a group of 10 contractors as a Delivery Owner.
Designed and developed a certification system for course completion in Java 8 with Spring Boot, JPA, and Thymeleaf, used nationwide to certify SSPC course attendance.
Developed several microservices in Java 8 with Maven for CRUD operations and inter-API communication via RESTful services.
Designed, managed, and implemented a Kubernetes cluster used to deploy microservices consumed across the country by law enforcement personnel.
Developed a web RESTful application for the tokenization, analysis, and processing of medical prescriptions to automate the insurance claim process.
Designed protocols for interactions between the client's API and SHIFT web solutions, enabling reuse of native APIs and seamless integration for claim automation.
Redesigned a monolithic system into a microservices architecture. Services were developed in Java 8, containerized with Docker, and deployed on a Kubernetes cluster.
Designed, managed, and implemented a Kubernetes cluster with 3 nodes for microservices deployment.

masters.department: Department of Networks and Data Science

aloha.title: Beyond the Limits of ALOHA Throughput with Reinforcement Learning
aloha.description: Research project exploring how Reinforcement Learning agents can push the theoretical throughput boundaries of the ALOHA protocol in network communications.

meta_ml.title: Meta-Machine Learning using Recommending Algorithms
meta_ml.description: Applied meta-learning techniques combined with recommendation algorithms to improve model selection and generalization across heterogeneous datasets.

image_seg.title: Image Segmentation using K-Means with Spatial Neighbours
image_seg.description: Extended classic K-Means clustering for image segmentation by incorporating spatial neighbourhood information, improving segment coherence and boundary accuracy.
